chronology_boundary: This is a successor reconciliation after merged PR #292. It does not backfill Zhang R9 into the earlier R10 context, review, or hash-chained trace.

merged_source_unit.source: Wei Zhang, Selmer groups and the indivisibility of Heegner points, Theorem 1.4(ii), Cambridge Journal of Mathematics 2 (2014), 191-253
merged_source_unit.exact_statement: For E/Q and p>=5 satisfying Theorem 1.4(1)-(4), analytic rank >1 implies corank_Zp Sel_{p^infinity}(E/Q)>=2 when the root number is +1 and >=3 when it is -1.
merged_source_unit.rank_two_specialization: Exact complex analytic order two has root number +1, hence corank_Zp Sel_{p^infinity}(E/Q)>=2 under those technical-prime hypotheses.
hypotheses: rho_{E,p} is ramified at each l||N with l congruent to +/-1 mod p
if N is not square-free then Ram(rho_{E,p}) is nonempty and, when it has size one, the number of primes l||N is even
p is good ordinary and p>=5
strict_nonclaims: no Mordell-Weil rank two, Sha finiteness, regulator, Tamagawa, torsion, period, or rank-two leading-term formula
no statement at every prime p
merged_source_unit.credit_recommendation: DISTINCT_STORED_SOURCE_BOUND_TRANSFER_CONDITION_IN_THE_BSD_PROOF_DAG; not a new theorem or literature-novel result. Credit belongs to the Zhang R9 source unit, not R10.
